name: isMdmManaged
definition: True when at least one mobile device is reported by the device management tool and every mobile device it reports is enrolled and managed; false when a reported mobile device is not managed or none is reported.
population: mobile devices (iOS, iPadOS, Android) that the device management tool itself lists; devices not enrolled in the tool are invisible to it
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete device list in which at least one mobile device is present and every mobile device shows a managed or enrolled state in a field the vendor documents; an unreadable list or state is not measured.
citations: NinjaOne public API v2: GET /v2/devices-detailed (nodeClass, approvalStatus)

changeLog.change: Registered with the first NinjaOne implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; field names confirmed against a read-only device list, but no tenant body replayed through the transform, so V0). Intune and Lookout already emit this key.
